assessments.reasoning: The digest-verified CTAN Illinois README supplies the Hunter Goatley copyright and the two restrictions. The January 22, 2004 document date appears in the README header above the comparison bound. [CTAN Illinois mirror README](https://ctan.math.illinois.edu/macros/plain/contrib/newsletr/README)

The digest-verified standalone file is served from the SPDX license-list-data repository at the tag target commit. Its bounded passage preserves the Hunter Goatley attribution and matches the README's 81 ordered tokens. [Pinned SPDX standalone text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/text/Newsletr.txt)

The digest-verified detail JSON is pinned to the same SPDX commit. Its licenseId is Newsletr and its decoded licenseText exactly equals the standalone text, including the Hunter Goatley attribution. The Fedora cross-reference is separate metadata. [Pinned SPDX detail JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/json/details/Newsletr.json)

The digest-verified GitHub API tag object for spdx/license-list-data names v3.29.0 and targets commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. That target matches the revision segment of each raw GitHub URL. GitHub reports the tag as unsigned. [SPDX annotated release tag](https://api.github.com/repos/spdx/license-list-data/git/tags/76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b)

challenge.method: Independently bounded each passage from the copyright line through the final period of restriction 2. Stripped TeX comment prefixes, case-folded, and compared ordered ASCII alphanumeric tokens. Also compared the passages after whitespace normalization, inspected the surrounding content and detail metadata, and checked the annotated tag target against both fixed URLs.
challenge.results: Both SPDX comparisons produced identical ordered sequences of 81 tokens and identical bounded text after prefix removal and whitespace normalization. The two years and two restriction numbers contribute four tokens. An alphabetic-only count gives 77, and whitespace splitting gives 80. Outside the bound, the README has a title, date, comment delimiters, an End marker, and project documentation. Each SPDX text ends with a newline after restriction 2. The detail JSON cites Fedora, and its cross-reference records match as false. Both fixed SPDX URLs contain the annotated tag's target commit.

limitations: The count of 81 uses contiguous ASCII alphanumeric tokens and includes numeric tokens.

The correspondence is limited to the bounded passage in the captured README and these two pinned SPDX representations. Publication provenance, other versions, and legal effect fall outside this finding.
reasoning: The README, standalone SPDX text, and decoded SPDX licenseText agree throughout the stated bound. The SPDX detail identifies Newsletr, and both SPDX paths use the commit named by the v3.29.0 annotated tag.
